linux-no-ss.reason: Other users' connections are listed without a process, and byte counts need `ss` (iproute2), which isn't installed.

linux-partial-running.reason: Other users' connections are listed without a process — naming them needs root.

macos-nettop-missing.reason: /usr/bin/nettop is missing, so connections can't be listed.

other-os-unavailable.reason: Whole-computer connections aren't supported on this system yet.

windows-idle.reason: Byte counts aren't shown on Windows: the system only keeps them per connection after an administrator turns them on.

windows-running.reason: Byte counts aren't shown on Windows: the system only keeps them per connection after an administrator turns them on.
